content: Thanks to @hacdias, I found this nice project: Awfice - the world smallest office suite. a word processor, a spreadsheet, a drawing app and a presentation maker each less than 1KB of plain JavaScript each is literally just one line of code packaged as data URLs, so you can use them right away, without downloading or installing The tools are very minimal, but it’s nice to see what’s possible with under 1 kilobyte of code. There’s also an article with some background information. https://github.com/zserge/awfice
name: Minimal Office Suite
